> help
Commands:
  status - show the calendar, nations, armies and cities
  map - show the 8x6 terrain map with city, army and fleet markers
  move <army> <x> <y> - move an army toward (x, y)
  buy <army> <city> <tons> - buy supply for an army at a city (free at your own city, paid abroad)
  attack-army <army> <target-army> - attack another nation's army (declares war first if needed)
  besiege-city <army> <city> - besiege an adjacent enemy city (declares war first if needed)
  attack-fleet <fleet> <target-fleet> - attack another nation's fleet (declares war first if needed)
  disband-army <army> - disband an army near one of your own cities
  join-armies <survivor-army> <absorbed-army> - merge one army into another
  join-units <army> <unit-index> <unit-index> - merge two of an army's own unit slots
  split-army <army> <new-army> <unit-index> - split one unit slot off into a new army
  order-city <city> <order-id> <points> - place a standing order on one of your own cities
  declare-war <nation> - declare war on another nation
  make-peace <nation> - propose peace with a nation you are at war with
  propose-alliance <nation> - propose an alliance to another nation
  propose-trade <nation> - propose a trade agreement to another nation
  accept-offer - accept the pending trade or alliance offer made to you, if any
  mobilize <slot-index> <new-army> - mobilize a ready recruitment slot into an army unit
  hire-mercenary <army> <pool-slot-index> - hire a mercenary unit from the mercenary pool
  recruit-standing <city> <unit-type> <troops> - recruit a standing unit at one of your own cities
  move-fleet <fleet> <x> <y> - move a fleet toward (x, y)
  order-fleet <city> <ships> <new-fleet> - order a new fleet built at a coastal city
  repair-fleet <fleet> <points> - spend repair points on a fleet's condition
  scuttle-fleet <fleet> - scuttle one of your own fleets
  split-fleet <fleet> <new-fleet> <ships> - split ships off into a new fleet
  join-fleets <survivor-fleet> <absorbed-fleet> - merge one fleet into another
  embark-army <army> <fleet> - load an army aboard an adjacent fleet
  disembark-army <army> - unload an embarked army
  buy-fleet-supply <fleet> <city> <tons> - buy supply for a fleet at a city
  fleet-transfer <from-fleet> <to-fleet> <ships> <supply-tons> <money> - transfer resources between two of your own fleets
  end - end your turn
  news - show the news log
  help - show this help
  quit - exit

> status
Week 1, Spring 270 BC (turn 0). Active seat: Northern League (north).

Nations:
  Northern League (north, human): treasury 500, unity 600, tax 15%
  Southern League (south, ai): treasury 450, unity 520, tax 20%

Armies:
  north-army-1 (Northern League) @ (3,2): 18500 troops in 2 units, supply 185t (100%), morale 68, moves 5
  south-army-1 (Southern League) @ (4,4): 6000 troops in 1 units, supply 60t (100%), morale 59, moves 9

Cities:
  arx "Arx" @ (2,1), owner Northern League: supply 400t, loyalty 90, fortification 60%
  portus "Portus" @ (5,2), owner Northern League: supply 250t, loyalty 70, fortification 40%
  meridia "Meridia" @ (3,4), owner Southern League: supply 300t, loyalty 65, fortification 100%

> map
Map (8x6):
~ ~ . . . " ^ ~
~ . A , . " ^ ~
~ . = n . P " ~
N . . . ^ . . ~
~ ~ . M s . ~ S
~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

Legend:
  A = Arx (Northern League)
  P = Portus (Northern League)
  M = Meridia (Southern League)
  n = Northern League army
  N = Northern League fleet
  s = Southern League army
  S = Southern League fleet

> move north-army-1 4 2
north-army-1 moved from (3,2) to (4,2), spending 1 of 5 moves.

> move ghost-army 0 0
Move rejected (movement.unknown-army): 'ghost-army' is not a known army.

> move south-army-1 0 0
Move rejected (movement.not-your-army): Army 'south-army-1' belongs to 'south', not 'north'.

> move north-army-1 3 -1
Move rejected (movement.out-of-bounds): (3, -1) is outside the 8x6 map.

> move north-army-1 4 4
north-army-1 moved from (4,2) to (4,3), spending 4 of 4 moves.

> move north-army-1 5 5
Move rejected (movement.no-moves-left): Army 'north-army-1' has no moves left this turn.

> attack-army north-army-1 north-army-1
battle.attack-army rejected (battle.same-nation): 'north-army-1' and 'north-army-1' both belong to 'north'.

> besiege-city north-army-1 arx
battle.besiege-city rejected (battle.own-city): City 'arx' already belongs to 'north'.

> attack-fleet north-fleet-1 north-fleet-1
battle.attack-fleet rejected (battle.fleet-same-nation): 'north-fleet-1' and 'north-fleet-1' both belong to 'north'.

> join-units north-army-1 0 1
armies.join-units rejected (armies.mercenary-unit): You can only join regular units together.

> split-army north-army-1 north-army-2 99
armies.split-army rejected (armies.invalid-unit-selection): Must select between 1 and 1 distinct, in-range unit indices to move to the new army.

> join-armies north-army-1 north-army-2
armies.join-armies rejected (armies.unknown-army): 'north-army-2' is not a known army.

> order-city arx fortify 1
city.order rejected (city-order.insufficient-treasury): Insufficient treasury (0) for fortify order costing 220 talents.

> declare-war north
diplomacy.declare-war rejected (diplomacy.self-target): A nation cannot declare war on itself.

> make-peace south
diplomacy.make-peace rejected (diplomacy.not-at-war): You are not at war with 'Southern League'.

> propose-alliance north
diplomacy.propose-alliance rejected (diplomacy.self-target): A nation cannot propose an alliance with itself.

> propose-trade north
diplomacy.propose-trade rejected (diplomacy.self-target): A nation cannot propose trade with itself.

> accept-offer
diplomacy.accept-pending-offer rejected (diplomacy.no-pending-offer): There is no pending offer to accept.

> mobilize 0 north-recruit-army
recruitment.mobilize-recruit-slot rejected (recruitment.unknown-recruitment-slot): Nation 'north' has 0 recruitment slot(s), so slot 0 cannot be mobilized.

> hire-mercenary north-army-1 0
recruitment.hire-mercenary rejected (mercenary.unknown-pool-slot): Mercenary pool slot 0 has no offer to hire.

> recruit-standing arx heavy_infantry 1000
recruitment.recruit-standing-unit rejected (recruitment.insufficient-treasury): Nation 'north' has 0 talents, which is less than the order's cost of 100.

> move-fleet north-fleet-1 999 999
naval.move-fleet rejected (naval.out-of-bounds): (999, 999) is outside the 8x6 map.

> order-fleet portus 10 north-fleet-2
naval.order-fleet rejected (naval.city-not-coastal): City 'portus' does not touch the sea.

> repair-fleet north-fleet-1 5
naval.repair-fleet rejected (naval.not-at-owned-city): Fleet 'north-fleet-1' can only be repaired at one of its own nation's cities.

> split-fleet north-fleet-1 north-fleet-3 5
naval.split-fleet rejected (naval.too-few-ships-to-split): Fleet 'north-fleet-1' has fewer than 20 ships and cannot be split.

> join-fleets north-fleet-1 north-fleet-3
naval.join-fleets rejected (naval.unknown-fleet): 'north-fleet-3' is not a known fleet.

> embark-army north-army-1 north-fleet-1
naval.embark-army rejected (naval.not-co-located): The army and the fleet must be on the same tile to embark.

> disembark-army north-army-1
naval.disembark-army rejected (naval.army-not-embarked): Army 'north-army-1' is not aboard a fleet.

> buy-fleet-supply north-fleet-1 portus 5
naval.buy-fleet-supply rejected (naval.city-not-within-range): City 'portus' is not within one tile of fleet 'north-fleet-1'.

> fleet-transfer north-fleet-1 north-fleet-2 1 1 1
naval.fleet-to-fleet-transfer rejected (naval.unknown-fleet): 'north-fleet-2' is not a known fleet.

> disband-army north-army-2
armies.disband-army rejected (armies.unknown-army): 'north-army-2' is not a known army.

> scuttle-fleet north-fleet-2
naval.scuttle-fleet rejected (naval.unknown-fleet): 'north-fleet-2' is not a known fleet.
